sentences.text: In the meantime, the order dated 29.06.2022 passed by the learned ACJM, Patna City in Complaint Case No.361 of 2020 whereby cognizance of offence under Sections 323, 341, 427 and 504 of the IPC has been taken, shall remain stayed.

5. The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that O.P. No.2 is husband of the petitioner no.1,
Priyanka Devi.

It is next submitted that there was matrimonial dispute in between the petitioner no.1 and the O.P. No.2, as such the O.P. No.2 was aware that a matrimonial case would be instituted by the petitioner no.1, as such to preempt Priyanka from instituting a case against him, the O.P.
No.2 instituted the present complaint on 22.06.2020 in which cognizance came to be taken on 29.06.2022.

6. The learned counsel next submits that Priyanka also instituted Bakhtiyapur P.S. Case No.220 of 2020 dated 19.09.2020 under Section 498A, 494 and 34 of the IPC read with section 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

7. The learned counsel thus submits that since O.P. No.2 without seeking divorce married another lady, as such he was aware that his wife would institute a case against him, hence he instituted the instant complaint against her and her Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.62514 of 2023(2)
dt.11-01-2024 family members to coerce her into submission so that Priyanka does not institute any criminal case against him.

(Satyavrat Verma, J)
